caption: 42 or 55 inches for a racing rig? The LG C6 42 is 932 mm wide and fills your view from 70 to 90 cm. The TCL QM7K 55 is 1227 mm wide and wants a meter or more, on a stand, so it suits a living room better than a small rig room. The TCL is about $599, the LG about $900. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #gamingsetup
title: 42-inch or 55-inch TV for a sim rig? It depends how far away it sits
